discourse.excerpt: Life in the world is impermanent. So are youth and wealth. Wife and children are also not permanent. Only truth and good name are permanent.
discourse.theme: Beneath the diversity of forms, all is impermanent but truth — and we are all the one cosmic Being.
discourse.title: Unity in diversity - the Fundamental Truth

reflection: Swami's Diwali teaching goes straight to the point: youth, wealth, even family — all impermanent. Only truth and a good name endure. And our true nature is not the lonely individual but the cosmic being — Samashti Jeevi. Before the day is out, do one small act that sees the one in the many: greet someone you usually overlook as a fellow spark of the same Divine. That is unity in diversity, lived. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 35, 4 Nov 2002)
seva_nudge: Call one family member or friend you have not spoken to in a while and simply listen — unity begins in your own circle.
